relations.subject: Takanobu Takahashi
relations.evidence: Takanobu Takahashi (高橋 孝信, Takahashi Takanobu; born 1951) is a Japanese Indologist, who is currently associate professor of Indian literature at International Buddhist University at Osaka, Japan.

relations.subject: Takanobu Takahashi
relations.evidence: He graduated in Indology from the University of Tokyo in 1979.

relations.subject: Takanobu Takahashi
relations.evidence: He travelled to Tamil Nadu, India between 1979 and 1982 to learn Tamil at the Madurai Kamaraj University under the guidance of scholars such as Tamilannal.

relations.subject: Takanobu Takahashi
relations.evidence: In 1989, he obtained his PhD in Indian literature from the University of Utrecht, for which he researched on the Akam genre of the Sangam Literature's love poetry and poetics from 1985 to 1988.
